description: SOC Lab Part 3 - normalization and enrichment for endpoint audit telemetry. This pipeline performs the processing work that Logstash would have done in the classic ELK pipeline, but inside Elasticsearch (Beats -> Elasticsearch ingest node -> index).

script.description: Normalize the auditd rule key (-k) into soc.rule_key regardless of which shipper produced the event. Auditbeat puts the rule key in tags[]; Filebeat's auditd module puts it in auditd.log.key.
